canada.title: Moncton to consider vacant land tax once allowed by province
canada.summary: Moncton officials say the city will consider a tax on vacant land and homes once allowed by the provincial government. The city's mayor and a councillor hope it will result in redevelopment of vacant downtown land and boost housing.

canada.title: Former Red Deer mayor seriously hurt in hit and run calls for stricter rules on e-bikes, e-scooters
canada.summary: Former Red Deer mayor Ken Johnston is calling for changes to e-bike and e-scooter rules in the central Alberta city after he was seriously injured by one of the vehicles in what police are calling a hit-and-run.

canada.title: Canadians are ready to spend this holiday season. Can they afford it?
canada.summary: Despite another year of economic uncertainty and high living costs, most Canadians appear to be feeling merry. Most heading into the holiday shopping season say they aren’t planning to cut back on gift spending.

canada.title: What it’s like running a business across from a construction site
canada.summary: Businesses in downtown Kamloops are being impacted by a multi-year construction project, with work underway to build a public arts centre.

canada.title: Combining Rockies, Foothills in new electoral district gets pushback
canada.summary: The Independent Advisory Panel on Electoral Boundaries wants to redraw the map affecting the town of Diamond Valley, Longview, Millarville and Bragg Creek, moving those communities into a new riding called Banff-Canmore-Diamond Valley. Questions are being asked about the rationale and the lack of public input.

canada.title: Radon gas triggers cancer battle and advocacy work for Sask. woman
canada.summary: Christine Elliott learned about radon gas and its risks after a cancer diagnosis.

canada.title: Trillium College students disappointed at selective return to classes
canada.summary: Students at one career college are decrying its approach to a provincewide pause on Ontario Student Assistance Program payments, with the school allowing only those who can pay without the financial aid to continue learning.

canada.title: Religious symbols ban for Quebec schoolchildren? Conservatives leave door open
canada.summary: Quebec Conservative Leader Eric Duhaime is leaving the door open to supporting the PQ government's plan to extend a religious symbols ban to elementary school students.

canada.title: After 7 years in Canada, young student faces deportation
canada.summary: A young student who has spent seven years in Canada is facing deportation as her classmates and teachers push the federal government to intervene.

canada.title: Manitoba creating independent disability advocate after human rights complaint
canada.summary: The Manitoba government will introduce legislation in the upcoming session to create an independent disability advocate.

canada.title: Manitoba real estate trust hopes to use new federal money to address homelessness
canada.summary: A real estate investment trust says the funding model it's used to build dozens of affordable units this past year could be replicated to help the federal government address homelessness in Manitoba.

canada.title: Jury hears closing arguments in trial of Saint John man accused of killing wife
canada.summary: Crown prosecutors and defence lawyers made their closing arguments in the trial of Saint John man charged with second-degree murder of his wife in the early hours of Christmas Eve in 2024.

canada.title: Man accused of threatening N.S. chief medical officer and daughter agrees to peace bond
canada.summary: Charges against a 31-year-old Cherry Brook, N.S., man who allegedly threatened Dr. Robert Strang have been dismissed after the man agreed to a five-year peace bond that prohibits him from communiciating with Strang or posting about him on social media.

canada.title: Colchester hears potential transit cost
canada.summary: The Municipality of Colchester council is holding out hope for a regional transit model, but the first step will be getting the Town of Truro council on the same route.

canada.title: ‘Name him’: Clergy abuse survivors call on church to identify N.L. priest sent for treatment in 1975
canada.summary: An international organization of clergy abuse survivors and advocates is calling on a Roman Catholic diocese in Newfoundland to release the name of a priest who was sent away for treatment more than 50 years ago.

canada.title: Survivor of fatal boat crash near Squamish speaks out
canada.summary: Spencer Seabrooke, a survivor of a fatal boat crash near Squamish, B.C., on Thursday, is speaking out about his experience. Three people died in the crash.

lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
United Airlines says it has a widespread system outage, just days after nationwide ground stop, The Associated Press reports.

Quebec Energy Minister Stéphane Paquet said the Churchill River power deal is not set in stone, setting off a series of questions for Premier Tony Wakeham in Newfoundland and Labrador’s House of Assembly, CBC News reports.
Ukraine strikes major Russian bridge with drones and missiles as aerial attacks escalate, The Canadian Press reports.
United Airlines said Monday that it had resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights, just days after a malfunction in the U.S, The Associated Press reports.
A collision on the Honoré-Mercier Bridge has forced the closure of one of two lanes heading toward the westbound Route 138, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
